title: Guardrail Mosaic: Multi-metric Regression Detector for Cost-driven Batch/Cache Applies
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, production-ready regression detector ("Guardrail Mosaic") that combines signal types to decide whether an automated batching/caching configuration recommendation should be applied, held for review, or automatically rolled back. The detector intentionally fuses behavioral fingerprints (response n-gram overlap and language-model perplexity), semantic embedding drift, latency/throughput deltas, and customer-facing metric proxies (satisfaction p99, error rates) into a single decision surface with conservative acceptance thresholds and human-in-loop escalation. This ticket scopes the core detection logic, the golden prompt corpus and stratified mini-eval harness, the canary/rollback triggers, observability dashboards, and integration points with the Config Apply Orchestrator service.
background: We continue to expand automated cost suggestions (batch and prefix cache profiles). Past incidents showed low-signal cost wins leading to subtle quality regressions that only surface on long-tail prompts or high-value customers. Existing eval suites focus on token-level deltas and isolated golden prompts; they miss multi-dimensional drift. Guardrail Mosaic aims to replace ad-hoc checks with a consistent, multi-metric acceptance flow that is fast enough for canary/autosuggests but conservative enough for automatic rollbacks.
plan: Design detection signal schema and scoring aggregation (weighting tunables)
Curate a 1.2k-item stratified golden prompt corpus: short queries, multi-turn, instruction-following, domain-sensitive prompts, and customer-sourced edge cases
Implement fast embedding-based semantic drift check using production embedding model with approximate nearest neighbor baseline cache
Add behavioral fingerprinting: n-gram JSD, top-k token distribution delta, and LM-perplexity delta against baseline model outputs
Instrument latency & throughput deltas against SLO windows and include cost delta signal
Develop a shadow-eval pathway that runs candidate config in parallel (shadow) for 24h against 5% traffic segment
Create rollback rule engine with deterministic thresholds and a human escalation ticketing hook
Ship observability dashboards: per-recommendation score breakdown, cohorted semantic drift, and a small-sample reviewer UI
End-to-end QA via synthetic chaos tests and a limited production pilot with two anchor customers
progress_updates: 2026-03-03: Kickoff meeting with Product, SRE, and Applied ML. Agreed on multi-signal approach and conservative default weights.
2026-03-05: Curated an initial golden prompt seed (360 items) pulled from anonymized high-sensitivity customers and internal black-box prompts. Stored in private GDrive folder.
2026-03-07: Prototype semantic-drift microservice implemented (embeddings + ANN) and benchmarked at 120ms median per-check; acceptable for 1% canary but needs optimization for 5% shadow.
2026-03-09: Behavioral fingerprint module completed (n-gram JSD + top-k KL). Early tests show it surfaces hallucination-style regressions missed by embedding checks.
2026-03-12: PR opened for the score-aggregation library (github.com/redwood-inference/guardrail-mosaic/pull/12). Requesting design review from PM and Applied ML.
decisions: Use a weighted linear scoring function with conservative defaults: semantic_drift_weight=0.5, behavior_weight=0.3, perf_weight=0.2. We will expose these as runtime feature flags.
Acceptance windows are asymmetric: require stronger evidence to approve an apply than to keep an existing config. This favors availability and quality.
Shadow evaluation will run for 24h with 5% traffic and a separate 1% canary apply window for low-impact configs only.
Human escalation required if aggregate score exceeds threshold_x OR the customer_cohort_impact flag is set true.
Rollback will be an automated deterministic apply of the previous persisted config plus a ticket to #ops-cost-guardrails channel.
acceptance_criteria: Guardrail Mosaic produces an aggregate score and per-signal breakdown for every candidate recommendation
Shadow-eval path validated end-to-end and able to process 5% production traffic with <5% additional p99 latency overhead
Automated rollback triggers are implemented and tested in staging with simulated regressions
Golden prompt corpus expanded to 1.2k items with metadata tags: customer-origin, complexity, dialog-depth, domain
False positive rate on internal test harness <= 2% (measured versus human audit) and true positive detection of seeded regressions >= 95%
Dashboards show per-recommendation history and allow drilldown to failing prompt examples with raw inputs/outputs
tests_and_qas: Seeded-regression suite: inject subtle semantic shifts and check detector fires and rollbacks
A/B shadow run: compare baseline vs candidate for 24h and compute distributional statistics
Human audit: sample 200 shadowed outputs across stratified bins and compute agreement score with detector
Performance stress test: run embedding checks at 5% traffic scale in staging cluster and measure CPU/GPU and latency impact
Chaos rollback test: force network errors and verify orchestrator recovers to previous config deterministically
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal-only): run Guardrail Mosaic in read-only mode for 7 days and gather baseline scores
Phase 2 (shadow): enable 5% shadow-eval on production traffic for 7 days; store all signals and human-audit a sample
Phase 3 (canary apply): allow automatic apply for non-customer-facing low-impact configs at 1% with auto-rollback on trigger
Phase 4 (wider rollout): expand to 10% traffic and allow apply for more config classes after 2 weeks of stable results
Phase 5 (GA): promote as default pre-apply gate for automated cost recommendations; include a manual override UI
rollback_triggers: Aggregate score delta > 0.45 in the direction of worse quality
Semantic cosine-similarity median drop > 0.02 absolute relative to baseline over golden set
Human-audit agreement indicates quality degradation in >10% sampled outputs
Customer-facing error rate (4xx/5xx or API-level failures) increase > 0.5 percentage points
Latency p99 increase > 20% for affected model route AND customer_impact != none
risks: Embedding-based checks can be brittle for very short prompts; mitigate by weighting behavior signals higher for those buckets
False positives may block legitimate cost savings; we will tune thresholds and provide manual override paths
ATTACK SURFACE: detectors leak aggregated customer prompt metadata if logs are misconfigured; ensure PII filters and retention policies
Operational cost: running embeddings at scale adds extra infra spend—cost must be <10% of projected savings for the first year
dependencies: Config Apply Orchestrator (ENG-671900) - must expose pre-apply hook
